author: (Valenciennes, 1847)

note.en: A large flyingfish of the open Atlantic; it glides over blue water but no local sighting is documented.
note.es: Un pez volador grande del Atlántico abierto; planea sobre aguas azules, pero no hay avistamientos locales documentados.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
